prose: An SF Chronicle report that Stanford violated its own AI policy after race-swapping students in an advertisement. The capture is an anti-bot challenge page, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: the university used AI to alter students' apparent race in marketing material - the diversity-illustration shortcut colliding with the institution's own rules on AI use. How it was discovered and what consequences followed are unknown from the capture.
highlights: SF Chronicle: Stanford violated its AI policy by race-swapping students in an ad
AI-altered photos used to present diversity in marketing
The university broke rules set for its own community
Capture blocked by anti-bot challenge; discovery and fallout unknown
